// <auto-generated/>
#nullable enable
namespace Acme.Trading;
public enum Side
{
    Buy,
    Sell
}

public readonly record struct Quantity(decimal Value);
public abstract record Order
{
    private Order()
    {
    }

    public sealed record Market(Side Side, Quantity Quantity) : Order;
    public sealed record Limit(Side Side, Quantity Quantity, decimal Price) : Order;
}

public static class Trading
{
    public static decimal Notional(Order order, decimal last) => order switch
    {
        Order.Market m => m.Quantity.Value * last,
        Order.Limit l => l.Quantity.Value * l.Price,
        _ => throw new System.InvalidOperationException()};
    public static System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<TOut> Map<TIn, TOut>(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<TIn> items, System.Func<TIn, TOut> f) => System.Linq.Enumerable.ToList(System.Linq.Enumerable.Select(items, f));
}
